programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: The men of the 283rd Medical Attachment, providing air ambulance support in Vietnam.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Combat story of 10th armored division in World War II, with focus on events related to fighting around Metz and Bastogne. Combat story of 10th armored division continued - fighting in Bastogne and ensuing events during push to Brenner Pass from December 1944 to April 1945.

programme.title: Operation Plunder The Rhine Crossing
programme.desc: This program covers the growth of German aggression, 1934-1940. Contains many animated maps explaining German tactics and many views of Adolf Hitler making speeches and in conferences. Shows a large Nazi rally and Axis-inspired riots in Belgium and France. Also shows a Nazi rally in Madison Square Garden. Included is footage of Joachim von Ribbentrop and Fritz Kuhn.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific examines Japanese military aggression and growth prior to World War II. It looks the creation of the puppet state Manchukuo in Manchuria and the eventual war with China. It examines Japanese imperial interests in Philippines, Malaya, Singapore, and Indochina and discussions the decision to bomb Pearl Harbor.
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Japanese Empire

programme.title: Great Battles Of The Civil War: Volume 2
programme.desc: This in depth volume combines archival material with faithfully created battle re-enactments to depict the real horror and heroism of the American Civil War combat from 1863-1865. Witness the sacrifice of over 600,000 patriots in fierce hand-to-hand combat and face-to-face warfare struggling to preserve their ways of life.

programme.title: Africa Freed
programme.desc: The conquest of Tunisia was a triumph for the United Nations, who on land, sea and air, worked as one. This film, together with another made by American Allies, shows how victory was shaped and achieved. Africa Freed tells chiefly of the part played by British arms as recorded by our cameramen who marched alongside. It is a tribute to those fighting with allies in American and France.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 6, 1944... Operation Overlord was a colossal undertaking. 150,000 Allied Forces landed on five beaches in Normandy, France. It was the first phase in the liberation of Western Europe. When GIs from the First U.S. Army landed, the Allies believed the Germans would withdraw to the Seine. The American Forces would then advance to Brittany, the banks of the Loire, and Paris, but they were wrong!

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: Total war extends the battlefields - in the Second World War, for the first time, civilian casualties far outnumbered those of military personnel. And a significant proportion of those casualties were victims of the bombing campaigns waged by both sides. What was the effect of living through 'the Blitz', what precautions were taken, what forms of shelter were constructed?

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This episode takes you through the tense hours of the largest seaborne invasion in history: Operation Neptune, often referred to as D-Day. The operation began the liberation of France and laid the foundations of the Allied victory on the Western Front.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: By 1942, the war has reached a global scale. This episode examines key battles in North Africa, the Pacific, and the Eastern Front, as well as the escalating human cost of the conflict. The tension builds as the Axis powers push forward, threatening to overwhelm their adversaries, and the world braces for what seems like an inevitable collapse.
programme.sub-title: Part 4 - The World on the Brink

programme.title: Iron Curtain - Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: By Stalin's 70th birthday in 1949, Soviet domination of Eastern Europe is complete. Cities bear his name, collectivization uproots families, the Church is persecuted, and youth indoctrinated. Jews face new purges, culminating in Prague's show trials. With fear gripping 80 million people, Stalin's death in 1953 finally sparks a wave of hope for change.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: The Communist invasion of Korea which led to the entry of the US Forces into the conflict.

programme.title: Hitler and Churchill: The Eagle and the Lion
programme.desc: On one side is Winston Churchill, one of the most revered men of the century. His humor, style, self-deprecation and audacity in the face of adversity is still regarded as a prime example of leadership and political courage. On the other side is Adolf Hitler, the most hated leader in contemporary history. His regime and his ideas represent fear, xenophobia, racism, and a hatred for humanity.

programme.title: Iron Curtain - Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: 1944-45. As the Red Army pushes toward Berlin, Stalin seizes Eastern Europe, exploiting postwar chaos to impose communist regimes. Industries are requisitioned, propaganda expands, and dissent crushed through arrests. Marxism-Leninism becomes the only creed. By the late 1940s, the Iron Curtain has fallen, sealing millions under Soviet rule.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Combat story of 10th armored division in World War II, with focus on events related to fighting around Metz and Bastogne. Combat story of 10th armored division continued - fighting in Bastogne and ensuing events during push to Brenner Pass from December 1944 to April 1945.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As the New Year dawned and the people of Britain faced the introduction of rationing, all eyes turned northwards to Scandinavia. U-Boat attacks increased and at Scapa Flow a German Air Raid claimed the first British casualties.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: On June 6, 1944, the Normandy Landings, officially called Operation Overlord, began. This massive battle was also the largest media operation ever, with hundreds of reporters capturing footage under heavy fire. Among the first waves on beaches like Juno, Omaha, and Utah, these brave photographers shaped our collective visual memory of World War II.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This episode takes you through the tense hours of the largest seaborne invasion in history: Operation Neptune, often referred to as D-Day. The operation began the liberation of France and laid the foundations of the Allied victory on the Western Front.

programme.title: The Tiger Files
programme.desc: An in detail look at the Tiger Tank from drawing board to the battlefield.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Story of the three-day attack on St. Vith and retreat of American troops when the town was lost to the Germans. Fighting by 84th infantry division in Battle of the Bulge, crossing of the Roer and Rhine, and the desperate race to the Elbe.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: The concentration camp deportees became the rare witnesses to mass extermination.

programme.title: Exploring Hitler's Berlin/Munich
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler was distant towards Berlin, preferring Munich. After taking power in 1933, he planned to transform Berlin into 'Germania,' a global capital designed by Albert Speer. Most projects were halted or destroyed by bombs. This documentary explores lesser-known Third Reich structures, including abandoned tunnels, Flak towers, bunkers, and rare images of Hitler's grand architectural vision.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 2016, over 200 unseen photos of Nazi officials surfaced, revealing the rise of a young Hitlerite group in concentration camps between 1928-1943. Dr. Stefan Hördler spent 5 years analyzing the images, uncovering how these men became perpetrators of horrific crimes. This investigation exposes a little-known chapter of the camps and challenges assumptions about their origins.
programme.sub-title: Unmasking the Killers of the Third Reich

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Hill 881 was one of the bloodiest battles of the war. During April-May 1967, two Marine battalions faced a large NVA force intent on destroying the Khe Sanh compound. The Marines stormed and took the hills overlooking Khe Sahn. Included are accounts by Dale Dye (whose films include Platoon, Finding Private Ryan, Band of Brothers) who fought as a Marine in Vietnam.

programme.title: Battle of the Bulge
programme.desc: In June 1944, after the enormous success of the D-Day landings, an end to World War II and Nazi tyranny seemed imminent. But in December 1944 with one last card to play, Adolf Hitler launched the greatest counter offensive in European military history. The world held its breath as Hitler's armies forged forward again to recover ground, forcing the Allies into a Chaotic retreat.

programme.title: World War II: The Real Mighty Eighth
programme.desc: A closer look at the men of steel, and the steel of industry that make up the heroes of The Mighty Eighth, following their roles, responsibilities, and profiling some of the gladiators of the sky. 8th Air Force bomber and fighter veterans discuss the experience of bailing out, and give witness to the courage and sacrifice of those who came home, and those who did not...

programme.title: Grey Wolves Part 1: The Killing Begins
programme.desc: Kaiser Wilhelm the 2nd of Germany had long desired to rule an empire. He thought that Germany needed a powerful Navy to protect it - especially against Britain. The Germany Navy was set to the ultimate test - war against Great Britain, putting their mighty fleet to good use. They began a naval blockade of Germany during the first days of the war and deployed their naval units.

programme.title: Heroes Never Die: The Miniseries
programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. A group of Ukrainian Army fighters heads to Donetsk airport for its defense. After being shelled by artillery on the way, a team of four volunteer fighters makes it to the airport to help reinforce. The name Cyborgs, Defenders of the Donetsk Airport, is given to the Ukrainian fighters for their grit, bravery and heroics.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: Eisenhower describes how the Allies squeezed Rommel's forces in Tunisia. The Afrika Korps attacks to the Kasserine Pass but is pushed back thanks to Patton. Allied air power helps win the day, the U.S. and British 8th Armies meet, and Tunis falls.

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Actor and peace campaigner, Mark Rylance explores the extraordinary story of his grandfather, Osmond Skinner, who spent almost four years as a Japanese Prisoner of War. Mark uncovers how Osmond, a banker for HSBC, bravely joined the Hong Kong Volunteer Defence Force and was thrown into a deadly battle to defend the island, then was shot on Christmas day and taken as a POW.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this first film of the series, '1939', follow the prelude to war and consider how the Treaty of Versailles, drawn up after the First World War, failed to keep the peace. Watch the rise of Adolf Hitler and Nazi Germany and learn of those who attempted to stop his bid for global domination. See for yourself the preparations made by the people of Britain as war became inevitable.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: America's Greatest Generals
programme.desc: A profile of General Dwight D. Eisenhower with a bonus program on General Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell.
programme.sub-title: Dwight D. Eisenhower, Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell

programme.title: Wings at War Collection
programme.desc: For many, the Normandy landings in June 1944 are most associated with the liberation of Europe. But it was almost exactly the year before that parts of mainland Europe began to throw off the Nazi yoke. The defeat of the German and Italian forces in North Africa enabled the Allies to launch their assault on fortress Europe beginning with Sicily. From here, the invasion of Italy was launched.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Operation Dewey Canyon, from January 22 through March 18, 1969, was the last major offensive by the United States Marine Corps during the Vietnam War. The 9th Marine Regiment reinforced by elements of the 3rd Marine Regiment swept through the A Shau Valley engaging in 56 days of combat mainly against the North Vietnamese Army.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: After training in Australia and New Zealand, the U.S. Marines land on Guadalcanal. The U.S. Navy suffers defeats by the Japanese Navy around the island-in an area called Ironbottom Sound.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: In 1939, bombers hit Polish cities, sparking fear and evacuations. By 1940, Britain faced the Blitz, though early German raids targeted airfields. Both Axis and Allies believed air attacks could break morale. The war revealed that bombing had no boundaries-and civilians were on the front lines.

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: K-9: P.I.
programme.desc: Finally ready to settle into a relaxing retirement, police Detective Mike Dooley and his trusty dog, Jerry Lee, inadvertently find themselves in the middle of a robbery investigation -- as suspects. With his pension now frozen until his name is cleared, Dooley is back on the case with Jerry to find the real criminals. However, since he's a suspect of an FBI investigation and therefore unable to access his old police resources, Dooley has to get creative.

programme.title: K-911
programme.desc: This sequel follows police Detective Michael Dooley and his faithful German shepherd partner, Jerry Lee, who have been working together for 10 years. For Jerry Lee, this means that the canine is quite old, and has a hard time keeping up with police duties. Joining the pair is fellow officer Wendy Welles and her tough Doberman pinscher. Together, Dooley, Welles and their respective dogs attempt to track down a gun-wielding psychopath.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: A devoted dog discovers the meaning of its own existence through the lives of the humans it teaches to laugh and love. Reincarnated as multiple canines over the course of five decades, the lovable pooch develops an unbreakable bond with a kindred spirit named Ethan. As the boy grows older and comes to a crossroad, the dog once again comes back into his life to remind him of his true self.

programme.title: A Dog's Journey
programme.desc: Bailey is living the good life on the Michigan farm of his boy, Ethan and Ethan's wife Hannah. He even has a new playmate: Ethan and Hannah's baby granddaughter, CJ. The problem is that CJ's mom, Gloria, decides to take CJ away. As Bailey's soul prepares to leave this life for a new one, he makes a promise to Ethan to find CJ and protect her at any cost. Thus begins Bailey's adventure through many lives filled with love, friendship, and devotion.

Determined to unseat Kull, Taligaro has a wizard resurrect the witch Akivasha to seduce and destroy the new monarch.

programme.title: Foundations of Eastern Civilization
programme.desc: Unpacking the Mandate of Heaven, a belief that seizure of power could be justified as an expression of divine will; how it resonates in Chinese political history for 3,000 years; the Zhou's overthrow of the Shang dynasty; the Zhou dynasty's legacy.
programme.sub-title: The Zhou and the Mandate of Heaven

programme.title: Foundations of Eastern Civilization

programme.sub-title: Great Ideas of the Zhou - Confucianism

programme.title: Foundations of Eastern Civilization

programme.sub-title: Great Ideas of the Zhou - Later Confucianism

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Examining the visual nature of Roman society and the key role of spectacular display; ranging from its center in the Roman Forum to its frontiers.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: This lecture provides a chronological, thematic and geographical framework; understanding the visual components of the Roman Empire; especially how different forms of governments and their citizens affect their art, architecture and public display.
programme.sub-title: A Brief Survey of the Roman Empire

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Learning the fundamental role of Rome's military in expanding the empire through conquest; creating and projecting the image of Roman power; introducing non-Romans to Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Conquest provides a reason for triumphal processions, sacrifices, games and other grand spectacles; it also allows for public and religious participation in a reinforcement of Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Touring the palaces of Rome's powerful rulers; seeing how power and culture are displayed in forms that are admired and imitated by lower social classes.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: As a stage for political, religious and social display, the houses of Roman elites celebrate Roman virtues and cultural identity; reinforcing to social equals and inferiors the influence of the inhabitants.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Touring the largest house in Pompeii and an enormous pleasure villa along the Bay of Naples; seeing how Greek material becomes the standard for Roman prestige display in public and private venues.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: The House of Octavius Quartio in Pompeii offers an example of what has been termed middle-class emulation of the elite use of Greek material.

programme.title: Masterpieces of Ancient Greek Literature
programme.desc: Learning to define ancient, Greek and masterpiece before moving on to discuss the importance of reading these works; knowing the best ways to do so.

programme.title: Masterpieces of Ancient Greek Literature
programme.desc: Introducing the Homeric epics; examining how the theory that they are composed orally might influence one's reading; summarizing essential mythological background before moving on to an overview of the "Iliad" and a deeper discussion of Book 1.
programme.sub-title: Homer I-Introduction to Epic and Iliad

programme.title: Masterpieces of Ancient Greek Literature
programme.desc: Exploring the themes and action of books 2-9 of the "Iliad"; the poet's imaginative presentation of chronology; a remarkable concentration of scenes that explore the possibility of peace or cooperation in the midst of war.
programme.sub-title: Homer II-Iliad, The Wrath of Achilles

programme.title: Masterpieces of Ancient Greek Literature
programme.desc: Completing the "Iliad"; focusing on Achilles's return to battle and its aftermath; learning that Homer's Achilles is not only Greece's greatest warrior but also a man struggling with the values of his culture and the awareness of his own mortality.
programme.sub-title: Homer III-Iliad, The Return of Achilles

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
programme.desc: The dynamic civilizations that emerge in the Aegean; the scope of the human drama that is played out there; some of the towering figures and remarkable sites to encounter; Professor Hale's recommendations for traveling this world as the ancients did.
programme.sub-title: Touring the Cradle of Western Civilization

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
programme.desc: The Acropolis is a symbol of Athens; the path of the ancient annual procession honoring Athena; the history and meanings of the site's iconic buildings; the superlative architectural features of the Parthenon and its surprising original uses.
programme.sub-title: Athens - Around the Acropolis and Parthenon

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
programme.desc: Treasures surrounding the Acropolis; the Theater of Dionysos, where one ponders the rituals of early dramatic festivals; the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, a venue of music and recitations; the Pnyx, an ancient hilltop assembly point; the agora market.
programme.sub-title: In the Footsteps of Socrates - Historic Athens

programme.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul
programme.desc: Visiting sacred monuments of Greece's beautiful Attica region; the Amphiareion is a shrine of a prophet deity; ancient oracle and healing practices; imposing shrines to Artemis and Poseidon; Eleusis is the site of mystical religious rituals.

programme.title: 1066: The Year That Changed Everything
programme.desc: What makes 1066 a pivotal year in the history of Western civilization; how the meaning of the Norman Conquest is debated and interpreted over time; how two weddings lay the groundwork for this moment; information for grasping the Norman Conquest.

programme.title: 1066: The Year That Changed Everything
programme.desc: A closer look at the chaotic half-century between 1016 and 1066; two figures are crucial during this time; Edward the Confessor, who succeeds to the English throne in 1042; William the Bastard, who brings the Norman nobles under control.
programme.sub-title: England and Normandy Before the Conquest

programme.title: 1066: The Year That Changed Everything
programme.desc: How the relationship between Edward the Confessor and William the Bastard puts England and Normandy on a collision course; Edward's plans for succession; meeting the contenders to the throne; Harold Godwinson at the Battle of Stamford Bridge.

programme.title: 1066: The Year That Changed Everything
programme.desc: Revisiting one of the most important moments in English history; Dr. Paxton investigates some mysteries and controversies about the invasion; she explains the tactics of medieval warfare; she provides a blow-by-blow account of the battle.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Macedonian Empire
programme.desc: Pondering Alexander's identity and story; learning about the ancient sources that contribute to people's understanding of Alexander's life and legacy; examining the ways this figure is perceived by modern scholars.
programme.sub-title: Alexander the Great - Conqueror or Tyrant?

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Macedonian Empire

programme.sub-title: Greece in the Age of Hegemonies

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Macedonian Empire

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Macedonian Empire
programme.desc: Although they ultimately unite Greece, Philip and Alexander are not considered full-fledged Greeks, learning about their barbarian homeland of Macedon and investigating its relationship to the more culturally influential city-states of Greece.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Midsomer Barton is celebrating Oak Apple Week when a mother is found drowned. It looks like suicide, and that she was driven to it by grief over her dead daughter. Barnaby investigates and is shaken by two villagers who look like murder victims from his past. Then another body is discovered, and it appears that the festivities have stirred up a cocktail of adultery, contempt, unrequited love and revenge in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The death of wealthy aristocrat Sir Freddy Butler brings Barnaby and Jones to the privileged surroundings of Haddington Hall. It looks like Freddy suffered a heart attack, but when his will disappears and his lawyer is killed in an arson attack, the detectives close in on Freddy's family. What are they hiding, and where are the mysterious Haddington diamonds?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When council clerk Martin Barrett is shot dead, Barnaby and Jones discover that he was an expert blackmailer. They investigate which of his victims hated him enough to kill him, and the trail leads to Fennacombe Bay. Why are Richard and Maggie Florian spending so much time at sea, and could police committee chairman Sir John Waverley have a scandalous past? With the help of Barnaby, they intend to find out.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A battle of the sexes which has raged in Broughton since the First World War comes to a head when ageing feminist Mildred Danvers is found dead after returning to her childhood home. As Barnaby investigates, the misogynist vicar Rev Gantis is shot through the head during a humiliating donkey race at the village fair. Is the killer on the side of the men or women - or do tragedies in Broughton's past hold the answer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Controversial plans to build a supermarket in Elverton-cum-Latterly lead to murder when a man is stabbed to death and the pollution advisor for the site seems to be spending more time with the women of the village than at work. Can Barnaby and Jones discover the truth and learn what is really polluting Elverton?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Midsomer Worthy's baritone Connor Simpson is killed just days before a competition, the rest of the choir, including Joyce Barnaby, are in fear for their lives. Then, there's another murder and the race is on to catch the killer before the choral showdown.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby begins to question the guilt of a Midsomer Malham woman who is on trial for the murder of her best friend. programme.sub-title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 3

His master will stop at nothing - including murder - to possess this book.

programme.title: Magnificent Wonderman from Shaolin

He must practice the secret martial arts of Fire Fist day and night to take revenge for the priest's death and restore the glory of the Shaolin Temple.

Ittou, however, arrived a day too late. Itto met Hatsuuchi's children, Aya and Soichiro, who appealed to him for revenge. Itto slays Rikuzo in the gambling hall, Abukuma while eating, and Asuke who was with a woman, one after another. When he kills Asuke, he tells the woman who was with him: "If you are asked, you must answer.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: "The lone wolf is blamed for the murder of a young samurai, now he's caught in between a vengeful mother and a deceitful corrupt official."

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ramiro consigue que Aurelio apoye sus planes con Omar para ponerle la mano al poder político, y le revela que Terán y Mónica son primos. Luzma se escapa con el Chef y llegan a casa de Cristina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de una noche de amor con Rutila, el Chema sale de su madriguera para ayudar a Feyo, sin imaginar los planes de Rivero. Mónica convence a Omar para que vaya a la cita con Ramiro Silva.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar está aterrado al saber que Ramiro lo escogió para ser presidente de México y que recibirá órdenes de Aurelio. El Chema escapa y hiere a Rivero, mientras Leonor rescata a Rutila y a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los estudiantes son ejecutados por orden de Feyo, quien, junto con el Chema, busca matar a los Casillas. Aurelio entrega su imperio a Mónica y Víctor. Rutila encuentra el dinero para huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le cobra con sangre a Cristina su traición, y la mata frente a Esperanza, mientras le jura a Feyo que se vengará por lo que le hizo a Alba. Tim captura al general venezolano en Aruba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En un atentado organizado por Aurelio para levantar la candidatura de Omar, Ignacio mata a Leonor en un acto de campaña. Pasan dos años, la salud de Casillas se deteriora y reúne a su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema y Feyo atacan a la familia Casillas y Luzma queda gravemente herida. Mónica está embarazada de Víctor, mientras él es víctima de una emboscada en Colombia, traicionado por Tijeras.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para vengarse de Feyo, Aurelio visita en la cárcel a María Sol y lo llama para que escuche cuando la ahorca. Desesperado, Aguilera advierte que matará a todos los Casillas. Javi salva a Víctor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Esperanza le ofrecen dinero a Amparo por el riñón de Carlitos, pero ella se niega. Mónica busca a Víctor y le dice a Casillas que está embarazada. Omar necesita saber quién mató a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Con ayuda del Oficial, Feyo se propone matar a Casillas y descubrir quiénes son sus aliados. Aurelio y Esperanza quieren seducir a Amparo. Omar pide a Ignacio averiguar quién le disparó a Leo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica tiene un mal presentimiento y pide a Javi que la ayude a sacar a Víctor de la selva. El Oficial se propone matar al Chema, mientras Ernestina informa a Ramiro que Aurelio está enfermo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Oficial y el Reyecito atacan con bazucas al Chema, quien jura venganza tras escapar. Furioso llama a Feyo y le dice que es el primero en su lista. Rutila llega con su hijo a casa de Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Ingeniero le dice a Torito que la era del Chema terminó, mientras Eleazar habla con Venegas para eliminar al Oficial, el Reyecito y Tijeras. Ramiro, interesado en Amparo, le ofrece trabajo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio advierte a Ramiro que los colombianos han exportado su guerra a México, le pide incluir a García en un operativo de la DEA. Bajo amenaza del Chema, Toro confiesa su traición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Junto a Esperanza, Aurelio se decide por el lavado de dinero y le deja el narcotráfico a Víctor; además, no perdona a Mónica por revelar su secreto. Cristina venderá información de Casillas a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema y Toro escapan del Ingeniero, quien se adueña de sus rutas y negocia con Eleazar. Garnica propone que Ignacio culpe a Marcado del asesinato de Leo. Esperanza negocia con el petróleo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar anuncia el fin de la guerra contra el narco para pacificar México. El Chema descubre que Aurelio está detrás de esto y se ofrece como trofeo, mientras García queda bajo el mando de Tim.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema se entrega en el operativo comandado por García y Tim. Aurelio lo borra de su lista de enemigos, le garantiza seguridad y que cuidará a Rutila y su hijo. La salud de Casillas empeora.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para conseguirle el riñón a Aurelio, Ramiro engaña a García, quien buscará a sus posibles hijos para atraparlo. Rivero renuncia por sus dudas sobre la detención del Chema, ahora corre peligro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Esperanza invita a Armando a casa de Aurelio para negociar el petróleo, el encuentro comienza mal. Con sed de venganza, Feyo se asocia con el Oficial y el Ingeniero para matar a los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para que no funcione la paz en México, el Oficial y Tijeras deciden matar a Rivero, engañan a Feyo e incluyen a Rutila. Armando le dice a Aurelio que Salazar y Abel Terán saben del negocio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Víctor que maneja el poder en México y negocia con inversionistas del mundo, porque él es el diablo. Mexicanos y colombianos listos para matar a Rivero, llegan Tim y Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila sobrevive al atentado y enfrenta a sus enemigos. Los colombianos y Don Feyo intentan eliminar a la hija de El Señor de los Cielos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas conoce a Ismael, su hijo, y le reclama a la Tata por haberlo mantenido en secreto. Abel piensa que la gente de Marco está manipulando a Omar y le pide ayuda a Mónica.
programme.sub-title: Aurelio conoce a su hijo Ismael

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas le dice a Ismael que es su padre y presenta a su hijo y a la Tata a toda la familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio busca al Feyo para matarlo. Casillas intenta cobrarle al viejo Aguilera meterse con su hija Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas no puede cumplir con su promesa de acabar con el Feyo. Aurelio le pide a Tim que haga desaparecer al alférez García, como muestra de su fidelidad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se acuesta con la Tata Guerra. Aurelio Casillas seduce a la madre de Ismael para que le ayude con el riñón.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María Eugenia quiere que su esposo Armando pague el rescate que piden por su hijo secuestrado, pero su esposo no está dispuesto a arriesgar el capital que tienen porque no hay garantías. Tina se hizo unas fotos con Ángel, pero este nunca se las entregó. Ahora ella descubre que las fotografías fueron utilizadas como carnada para cazar a depredadores sexuales.
programme.sub-title: La realidad de un secuestro; Caza depredadores

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maruchka demanda a su amiga Lily por publicar un video de ella donde se muestra su sobrepeso. Julio y Martina están en desacuerdo sobre el medicamento que le recetó el pediatra a su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Lilian murió en un ataque de pánico provocado por unos alumnos de su colegio que dijeron que el ICE estaba en la escuela. Ahora Lilian demanda a Sara y Amaris, las madres de esos niños. Samuel es modelo y fue contratado por la agencia de David, quien presuntamente fue víctima de unos hackers que robaron toda la información privada de sus clientes, afectando entre todos a Samuel, quien debe más de 30 000 dólares.
programme.sub-title: Terror a la migra; Venta de información

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pedro fue golpeado por vándalos y en la cirugía dañaron su cerebro, ahora no controla sus instintos sexuales. Alexandra descubre que su inquilina tiene un negocio clandestino de placer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El interés en una herencia ha motivado a Sandra a hacer lo imposible para que Wilmer no sea el beneficiado y de esta forma mantener a su hija como heredera. Melissa quiere recuperar a su hijo, que fue adoptado por Raúl, quien, junto a su esposa, ha cuidado al niño como parte de un negocio con el padre del chico, que es un capo que está en la cárcel y pronto saldrá a buscar al niño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cleris le exige a Stephanie que le devuelva a su hijo, lo dejó con ella para alejarlo de su padre, un militar cubano. Amanda demanda a su madre por dejarla con su padrastro, él abusó de ella.
programme.sub-title: El hijo del coronel; Protector depredador

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luego de dos meses en coma, tras una pelea doméstica, ya no tiene a sus hijos y ahora los quiere de vuelta. El esposo los descubre en la cama y, en medio de la pelea, el amante lo mata y huye.
programme.sub-title: El disparo oscuro; Amor a palo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yuleika cree en la tradición latina de que los golpes enseñan y lo aplica con su hija de 20 años, incluso delante de su nieto. Isabela denuncia a su papá con la policía y lo deportan.
programme.sub-title: Quiero ser de ella; La niña detective

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gustavo es guardaespaldas y fue baleado durante el secuestro de la familia que protege. Además, Jorge descubre a Yanelis con el mecánico, ambos estaban en el garaje, desmayados y desnudos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Olga ha dedicado toda su vida al cuidado de su hija, quien nació con problemas neuronales. Por otro lado, Rosa se enamora de un chico mucho más joven que ella y decide divorciarse.
programme.sub-title: La muerte, una opción; Señora de las cinco décadas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Acusan a David de violar a Aidé, pero ella asegura que él de quien abusó fue de su hermana. Le entrega los ahorros a su marido para comprar un camión, pero él lo invierte en su otra familia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Fernando no quiere más hijos, pero su esposa se aprovecha de él mientras duerme para tener sexo. Lázaro vandaliza la empresa de Orlando porque envía suministros a la dictadura de Daniel Ortega.
programme.sub-title: Detrás de la niña; Suministro al diablo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lo protege durante el día, pero de noche lo viola y le dice que él es gay. Rafael descubre que su esposa Doris tiene en la casa un negocio de prostitución con muñecas inflables.
programme.sub-title: Fui violado, me too; Prostitución legal

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Fue detenida por tráfico animal, ella culpa a Roberto por la tortuga que lleva en la vagina. Exige emanciparse de su padre por su comportamiento violento, él alega que la agresiva era la madre.
programme.sub-title: Tortuga en la vagina; Me enseñaste a odiarte

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo muere porque la ambulancia no llegó a tiempo al hospital, ella demanda al chofer. Pablo y Ernesto tienen una relación de amor, odio, deseo y celos que no los deja vivir en armonía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Exige el divorcio, su esposo la engañó con la amante y extrajo dinero de la cuenta, según ella, para matar a su difunto padre. A Juliana le cancelan el contrato porque creen que no es mujer.
programme.sub-title: Recuperar mi herencia; Mujer o mujer trans

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carmen recupera a su hija, pero Lucía y Alejandro insisten en que la niña estaba mejor bajo sus cuidados. No quiere que su anciana madre practique la kunyaza, una técnica de placer sexual.
programme.sub-title: Mamá drag; El poder del hombre moreno

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere ser la guardiana del amigo de su hijo para llenar el espacio que él dejó al morir. Escapa para evitar ser descubierto y se lesiona, ahora no puede practicar su pasión: el paracaidismo.
programme.sub-title: Nos quitó la vida; Venganza de la ex

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La boda entre Jenifer y su novio se cancela, pero ella se niega a devolver el anillo de compromiso. Teresa contrata a John como enfermero, una inyección demostró que él es un farsante.
programme.sub-title: Como anillo al dedo; Sacada de sangre mortal

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos y John quieren adoptar a las gemelas de Orlando, quienes se quedaron sin mamá. Además, despiden a Zuli del bar donde trabajaba porque no supo comportarse durante una fiesta fetiche.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La madre de Eduardo está en vida vegetal y ahora su padre reaparece para recuperar a la familia. Por otro lado, Fernando descubre que su ex involucra a su niño en estafas de seguros de autos.
programme.sub-title: Buscando el perdón de mis hijos; Hijo por adicción

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gilberto es menor de edad y se casa, sin permiso, con una mujer mucho mayor que él. Además, Leo y Pikete son dos "influencers" que sostienen una rivalidad para ver quién tiene mayor alcance.
programme.sub-title: Sacrificio por amor; Pelea en redes sociales

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Franco es policía y demanda a su ex Johana porque ella finge el secuestro de sus hijos para huir de sus maltratos. Exagente de ICE deporta a su papá, ahora quiere hacer lo mismo con su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Arlet pide el divorcio de Víctor, él tiene otras mujeres a quienes obliga a comportarse como si fuesen perras. Sofía vive en una tribu de madres solteras, el padre de su hijo exige la custodia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Talía la botan de la casa por enseñar a la hija de Jenny a bailar y a cobrar por hacerlo. Annette demanda a Angélica, dueña del hogar de ancianos donde su madre se enamoró de otra mujer.
programme.sub-title: La bailarina exótica; Los viejos se rebelan

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hermana de Stefany murió de sobredosis y ella exige la herencia que la difunta le dejó a su secta sexual. Ashley parece menor de edad y extorsiona con sexo, su hermana pide desalojarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alberto busca hospitalizar a su mujer embarazada, porque ella consume marihuana para controlar la epilepsia. Zarina trabaja como modelo en la empresa de Sistina, le exigen prostituirse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ángel cree que su mamá tiene relaciones con el enfermero, pero quien las mantiene es su padre. Aura toma fotos de sus hijos desnudos, ahora uno de ellos dice que las gráficas lo perjudican.
programme.sub-title: Me duele mucho; El más buscado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un hombre enloquece y dispara en un centro comercial, el padre de un fallecido exige las armas del asesino para destruirlas. Jóvenes se vendan los ojos y realizan actividades peligrosas.
programme.sub-title: Subastando la muerte; El reto de los ojos vendados

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés busca anular el matrimonio de su hermano discapacitado porque Tairy se aprovecha de él. Cristina le aumenta los glúteos a Tatiana y la inyecta, ella hackea su Facebook para denunciarla.
programme.sub-title: Descarada sin vergüenza; Por un par de nalgas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Santiago, entrenador de tenis, pierde su trabajo porque María lo acusa de acosar sexualmente a su hijo. Por culpa de Ángel, la policía le incauta un dinero falso y con rastros de coca a Nicole.
programme.sub-title: Adolescente maldito; Billete sucio ganado limpio

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis le exige el divorcio a José porque se fue de viaje y le ocultó que su madre le pegó a los niños. Daniela exige que Esteban se someta a una terapia para eliminar su fetiche de voyerista.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tony cree que los videos de Alejandra para cazar un Sugar Daddy son su perdición. Jaqueline autoriza la desconexión de un hombre hospitalizado, pero este resultó ser el padre de otra persona.
programme.sub-title: Explotación de hombres; Papá está vivo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paola exige que Tatiana le pague la renta o desaloje su casa, pero ella pagó a la inmobiliaria. La novia de Nahuel le pone una visa "fiancé" y se la niegan porque la ex, Elizabeth, tenía otra.
programme.sub-title: Vivienda robada; Las fiance del marinero

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrea pide 15 mil dólares y orden de alejamiento para Jessica, quien le dio testosterona. Roxana exige que su ex retire de internet los videos que publicó para probar que era un cornudo feliz.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vianey quiere proteger a su hermana, pues su madre permitió que su padrastro la abusara sexualmente. Clara le disputa a César la custodia de sus dos hijos, lo considera una mala influencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tamara queda embarazada sin saber cómo, porque es lesbiana y no le ha sido infiel a su pareja. Laura tiene leucemia y ha mejorado con marihuana, pero le es difícil consumirla porque es ilegal.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marie y Neysi reciben clases de baile, las graban y suben los videos a la web para ser vistas por presos. Elisa pierde a un cliente porque Garnet la denunció como secuestradora de su hija.
programme.sub-title: Demasiado con tres y se sumó uno; Babysitter chapeadora

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonio un cazatalentos de jugadores de béisbol, termina involucrado en un problema de drogas. Luis le dijo un piropo fuera de tono a Isabel, y ella reacciona mal al sentirse acosada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Mateo, creador de un personaje anónimo de magazine, lo presionan para que dé la cara. Heidy decidió viajar por el mundo, pero sus vacaciones las pagan los hombres que encuentra en el camino.
programme.sub-title: Mujer que no existe; La pandora

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José Ángel le dispara al perro de su vecina, ella pide compensación, él alega que fue en defensa propia. Venda un ovario y años después se entera de que en la cirugía le extirparon el útero.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa has fun watering the flowers when a watering can appears. The Teletubbies watch some children making flowers. The Teletubbies make up a dance. The animals are on the march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Three Teletubbies dance through Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Dipsy climbs a steep hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: All four Teletubbies pop up to say hello. The Teletubbies watch some children joining in with Debbie. Laa-Laa makes up a song, which makes the other Teletubbies run away.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little girl whose Mum has a very special job. Po has too much Tubby Custard and Tubby Custard Tummy and there's time foe one more dance before Tubby Bye-Bye.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po feels like having some Tubby Custard. The Teletubbies watch some children visiting a conservatory and drawing cacti. Tinky Winky goes for a walk. Five birds appear in Teletubbyland and the Teletubbies dance round the flowers.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making bubbles. Magic things happen when Laa-Laa bounces her ball all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet brings a message that makes Laa-Laa laugh. The Teletubbies watch some children learning about the number one. The Teletubbies take turns to wear the skirt.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet brings a message, which makes Po laugh. The Teletubbies watch Mark and Zoe decorate cake with butter icing, chocolate and strawberries.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
